Built for the field

Engineered by students, for farmers

AgriPower Solutions started as a mechanical engineering project with a simple question: why should a farmer buy a separate machine for every job?

Our answer is one robust power unit and a range of attachments. Each tool uses a steel frame, adjustable settings and a quick-attach system, so small and emerging farms, community projects and livestock operations can do more with one investment.
